_meta.note: Every number the game uses. 1 crore = 1e7 INR, 1 lakh = 1e5 INR. Values are real (2025-26 rupees) unless estimate:true. The only scaling is in section 'game'. All aero tariffs exclude GST.

landing_dom_narrow_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_dom_narrow_per_t.note: No MTOW slabs in any current DEL/BOM/BLR order: DIAL splits narrow (ICAO Code A/B/C) vs wide (D/E/F). ZMI uses the DIAL card as its opening rack rate.

landing_dom_wide_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing

landing_intl_narrow_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing

landing_intl_wide_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_intl_wide_per_t.note: A380 is Code F, so wide rate applies.

landing_min_per_landing.note: Billed on next rounded-up tonne. Domestic scheduled aircraft under 80 seats exempt.

landing_mial_dom_intl_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_mial_dom_intl_per_t.note: Flat, no slabs, no wide/narrow split. Reference only.

landing_bial_dom_intl_per_t.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per landing
landing_bial_dom_intl_per_t.note: Falls to 295/374 from 2030-05-01. BIAL bills on nearest tonne. Reference only.

parking_contact_per_t_hr.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per hour

parking_remote_per_t_hr.unit: INR per tonne MTOW per hour

parking_free_minutes.note: 2 h free + 15 min taxi-in + 15 min taxi-out. MIAL: 2 h on-blocks to off-blocks, no taxi allowance.

parking_multipliers.unit: x base rate, hours after free period

udf_intl_biz_arr.note: Exempt: transit within 24 h on same ticket, children under 2, crew on duty, diplomats, armed forces (p.422).

udf_greenfield_opening_nmia.period: NMIA ad-hoc AERA order 2025-06-20; kept in CP1 order effective 2026-06-01
udf_greenfield_opening_nmia.note: Greenfield precedent: a new airport's UDF opens far above a mature one's. ZMI era-1 UDF starts here.

dial_yield_per_departing_pax.note: PV target revenue Rs 9,579.45 cr / 221.68 m departing pax. Total-traffic yield Rs 216.07.

dial_yield_nominal_per_pax.note: About +148%. TDSAT allowed DIAL's appeal (GMR filing 2026-09-20, https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/GMRINFRA_20092026204537_20092026-DIALTDSATORDER.pdf), so CP4 may be revised upward.

mtow_t.note: A321neo, A350, A380, 747-8I are secondary (Wikipedia). Legacy 787-9 airframes 254.7 t.

example_landing_fee.note: Arithmetic on the DIAL card and max MTOW; actual CoA MTOW may be lower.

hybrid_till_nar_share.unit: fraction of non-aero revenue deducted from aero revenue requirement
hybrid_till_nar_share.note: ARR = FRoR x RAB + D + O + T - 0.30 x NAR. DIAL/MIAL SSA: S = 30% of revenue-share-asset revenue. Before 2017: single till (1.0). Unverified Jul-2026 report of a move back toward single till: use only as a possible future shock.

control_period_years.period: AERA Act 2008 s.13; DIAL CP4 FY2025-29
control_period_years.note: Mid-period review allowed in public interest (s.13(2)). Major airport = more than 35 lakh pax/yr.

fair_return_on_equity.note: Range in AERA practice: 15.17% (HYD CP3, upheld by TDSAT 2024) to 16% (DIAL CP1/CP2).

wacc_dial_cp4.unit: % WACC (fair rate of return on RAB)

efficient_cost_of_debt.note: True-up uses lower of actual or MCLR+150 bps. Spread tied to AA- rating.

dial_rab_fy25_cr.note: Falls to 13,258.93 (FY28), 13,407.24 (FY29). Benchmark for ZMI's AERA order screen.

dial_target_revenue_cp4_cr.note: DIAL asked Rs 41,921 cr. True-up of CP3 = -852.04 cr (over-recovery refunded).

uncapitalised_project_penalty.note: AERA deducts 1% of cost for projects not capitalised on time.

sq_rebate_max_of_arr.note: Up from 4% today (1.5 obj + 2.5 subj) to 5% (4 obj + 1 subj). 0.25% per parameter group missed per month. Recovered via lower UDF in the next-but-one half-year. Draft, no final order as of Oct 2026.

sq_incentive_max.note: Offsets only rebates for parameters missed in <3 of 6 months; carries forward 6 months then expires.

del_lines_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: retail INR 9.2 bn, F&B 3.3 bn, advertising 2.3 bn / 79.3 m pax.

hyd_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: INR 6.3 bn / 29.5 m. Lines ~ retail 68, F&B 44, parking 27, advertising 27 (attribution from context).

bom_per_pax_fy25.note: Derived: 62% x Rs 4,571 cr / 55 m. MIAL counts cargo, ground handling, rentals as non-aero.

adani_network_per_pax_fy26.note: Ceiling reference for a mature commercial hub.

dutyfree_spp.unit: INR per passenger (GMR SPP basis, likely intl departing)
dutyfree_spp.note: Full-year FY25 figures (1,010 / 727) could not be verified.

zmi_per_pax_start.note: Anchored on HYD ~214 and BLR ~246: new hub, low intl mix.

zmi_per_pax_mature.period: era 4+ with intl >= 20% and duty-free mature
zmi_per_pax_mature.note: Between DEL 417 and BOM ~515; Adani network 672 shows headroom.

zmi_mix_share.note: From DEL/HYD line items (retail ~28%, F&B ~10-20%, advertising ~7-13%, parking ~13% at HYD); duty-free share assumed.

dwell_elasticity.unit: % change per 1% change in dwell time
dwell_elasticity.period: Wu, Morlotti & Mantin, JATM 118 (2024), 89 US airports
dwell_elasticity.note: Holds at linear and finger-pier terminals, not concourse airports.

delay_spend_shape.note: Delay raises spend up to a point, excessive delay cuts it. No threshold published.

delay_spend_peak_min.unit: minutes of delay at which spend uplift peaks
delay_spend_peak_min.note: No published threshold; 60 min chosen. Below it calm extra dwell adds spend; above it stress removes it, and a misconnect/cancel drops spend to ~0.

delay_proximity.unit: seconds near outlets per 10 min of delay
delay_proximity.note: Proximity, not spend. Most delay time does not become shopping.

satisfied_pax_shop_ratio.unit: x likelihood to shop (most vs average satisfied)
satisfied_pax_shop_ratio.note: Also +7% retail, +10% duty-free spend. Industry survey, not peer-reviewed.

transfer_vs_od_spend.unit: ratio transfer / O&D non-aero per pax
transfer_vs_od_spend.note: No primary figure. Transfers generate no parking or landside spend (~13% parking at HYD). Range 0.6 (tight D-D) to 0.9 (3h+ I-I).

opex_per_pax.unit: INR per passenger (O&M excl. revenue share)
opex_per_pax.note: Derived: Rs 1,467.01 cr / 73.67 m pax. Manpower ~40, R&M ~33, power gross ~34 (net ~9), housekeeping+hire+security ~26. CISF security is funded by the Aviation Security Fee, not operator O&M.

runway_open_per_hour.note: No published figure. ARFF ~12,200/h (90 staff x Rs 10 lakh + 5 CFT x Rs 5 cr / 15 yr) + AGL power 1,500-2,500/h + pavement/AGL 11,000-14,000/h (Rs 106.8 cr rehab every 10-12 yr + R&M). Range 24,000-29,000. ~Rs 23 cr/yr at 24x7.

atc_notional_per_hour.note: ATC is AAI's sovereign service billed to airlines (TNLC/RNFC), not the concessionaire. Charge it to the operator only if the game wants it; range 3,000-5,000.

arff_min_vehicles_cat9_10.note: Cat 9 (777-300ER) 24,300 L; Cat 10 (A380) 32,300 L water at level B.

cft_unit_cost_cr.unit: INR crore per crash fire tender
cft_unit_cost_cr.note: CP3 derived from Rs 25.10 cr for 5 CFTs (Fire Station 5 for runway 11L/29R).

runway_rehab_cr.unit: INR crore per full-length rehab programme

revenue_share_per_pax_dial.note: 0.46 x Rs 5,734 cr / 79.3 m. Larger than all O&M per pax.

hold_burn_kg_min.note: No public per-type table. Anchored on EUROCONTROL averages; +/-20% with weight and altitude.

atf_delhi_apr2026.note: Mumbai 98,247. Foreign carriers' intl uplift and non-scheduled ops: Rs 2,07,341.22/kL (+114.5%) during West Asia crisis. Centre's Rs 10,000 cr price-stabilisation advance from Jun 2026.

atf_nagpur_game.note: No published Nagpur price. Mumbai Apr-2026 98,247 + inland freight; Maharashtra VAT cut 18%->7% (15 May-14 Nov 2026) lowers it ~9.3% in that window.

atf_shock_multiplier.note: 207,341 / 96,638. Use for the 'fuel shock' era event.

hold_cost_per_min.note: kg/min / 0.80 x Rs 100/L. Borne by the airline, not the airport.

liable_party.period: CAR Sec 3 Series M Part IV, Rev. 3 (2019-02-27), amended 2023
liable_party.note: Airport owes nothing under the CAR; the airline may recover from third parties under contract/tort. ZMI's money exposure is via AERA SQ rebates and airline goodwill.

extraordinary_exempt.note: Weather, ATC, strikes, govt orders, security: no cancellation comp and no delay facilities. Refund/alternate duty remains. Not for denied boarding.

refund_option_delay_h.note: Alternate within 6 h or full refund.

cancel_comp_inr.unit: INR max per pax (or fare+fuel if lower)
cancel_comp_inr.note: Only with <24 h notice or missed same-ticket connection; plus full refund or alternate.

denied_boarding_comp_inr.unit: INR max per pax (200%/400% of fare+fuel)
denied_boarding_comp_inr.note: Connections: first-leg airline pays if final arrival >= 3 h late (3.2.3).

fog_cancel_threshold_h.note: Permissive: airlines may cancel in advance.

meal_cost_inr.note: CAR sets no amount. Range 300-500 (airport food court).

hotel_cost_inr.note: CAR sets no amount. Range 3,000-6,000 (tier-2 mid-range).

gearing_debt_share.note: Noida 65:35 (Rs 3,725 cr SBI + Rs 2,005 cr Zurich equity); Noida CA caps termination Debt Due at 70% of TPC; GHIAL/DIAL expansions 70:30; BIAL CP4 80:20; NMIA ~80:20 (inferred). Game slider 60-80%.

loan_tenor_years.note: NMIA: 23 yrs incl. construction and moratorium, maturing Dec 2044 (CRISIL Jun 2024), Rs 12,770 cr from 8 lenders.

loan_tenor_cap_fraction.note: RBI Project Finance Directions 2025 (from 2025-10-01): 85% of economic life.

loan_rate_base.note: Observed 8.7-10.2%: DAPS 9.0% (A), GHIAL NCDs 8.9-9.1% (AA+), Mopa post-COD NCD 10.0% (A), AERA benchmark 10.15% (AA-). Game: 9.5% +/- 1% by rating.

loan_rate_construction.note: Pre-COD greenfield debt is dearer: Mopa pre-COD MLDs 13.25-13.90% (small tranches) vs 10% after COD. Bank term loans undisclosed; 10.5% chosen. RBI 2025: 1% provisioning in construction vs 0.40% operational.

refi_rate_after_stability.note: GHIAL AA+ 10-yr NCDs 8.9-9.1%; BIAL AAA refinanced Rs 9,000 cr in a 15-yr NCD (Jul 2025).

dscr_covenant_min.note: GMR cargo term loan: 1.15x (ICRA Jul 2022). Tested every 6 months.

dscr_warning.note: MIAL: no distributions below 1.20x; 50% below 1.40x; 75% below 1.55x; 100% above 1.55x. ICRA downgrade trigger for BIAL/DAPS: cumulative DSCR < 1.40x.

dscr_default.unit: x DSCR (two consecutive eras -> lender step-in)
dscr_default.note: Real facilities default at the 1.10-1.15x covenant; 1.0 means operating cash cannot cover debt service at all (DSRA draw). Game uses 1.0 as the hard line, 1.10 as covenant breach.

termination_concessionaire_default.note: Before COD nothing is paid on the first 40% of TPC spent.

termination_authority_default.note: Adjusted Equity decays 0.17%/month from 4th anniversary of COD.

equity_irr_benchmark.note: Fairfax India DCF across BIAL business units; LT growth 3.5%.

equity_irr_target.note: Mid of AERA allowed CoE 15.17-16% and Fairfax 12.4-17.3%. No sponsor publishes a target IRR.

covid_force_majeure.period: award Dec 2023/Jan 2024; upheld Delhi HC 2025-03-07; DB appeal pending
covid_force_majeure.note: Use for the pandemic shock: revenue share excused ~23 months + concession extended. AAI deposited Rs 471 cr with the court.

nmia_phase1.note: FPJ: Rs 19,647 cr. News figure. 1 runway. ~Rs 983 cr/MPPA.

nmia_full.note: 'Up to Rs 1 lakh crore' is a loose verbal estimate.

nmia_capex_to_fy30_cr.note: 22,531 under way + 34,802 further. Operator proposal = upper bound.

noida_full.note: Phases 4,588/5,983/8,415/10,575 cr for 12/30/50/70 MPPA; ~Rs 422 cr/MPPA; price base unstated; Phase IV includes aerotropolis.

dwc_terminal.unit: AED bn / USD bn / INR crore / MPPA

greenfield_phase1_cr_per_mppa.note: NMIA 983; Noida 933 (838 at 10,056; 743 at 8,916). Single-runway phase 1s.

brownfield_cr_per_added_mppa.note: DEL Phase 3A 9,800/34 = 288 (incl. 4th runway); BLR T2 13,000/45 = 289; range 200-300. ZMI era expansions use this.

runway_new_hub_cr.unit: INR crore per hub runway (2025 prices)
runway_new_hub_cr.note: BLR south parallel runway L&T EPC Rs 1,358 cr (Nov 2017, incl. apron) inflated ~5%/yr. Basic 3 km runway (HAL Nashik) Rs 200 cr is the floor.

zmi_phase1_mppa.source: design.md (ZMI full build 209 MPPA; phase 2 to 260)
zmi_phase1_mppa.note: Phase 1 sized for Level 1-2 traffic: BLR ~44.5 m moves in at opening; HYD+AMD (~44 m) arrive in year 8, triggering the first expansion. Range given 60-80.

zmi_phase1_cr_per_mppa.unit: INR crore per MPPA (2025-26, excl. land)
zmi_phase1_cr_per_mppa.note: Below single-runway phase 1s (930-983) because two runways and a large headhouse spread fixed site cost over 70 MPPA; above Noida full-plan 422 (bid-era prices, ~600 inflated). Land excluded: the state contributes it.

zmi_phase1_capex_cr.note: 70 x 800 = 56,000. Cross-check: NMIA operator capex to FY30 Rs 57,333 cr; Al Maktoum ~Rs 1,112 cr/MPPA would give 77,800.

zmi_construction_years.note: NMIA ~4 yrs from Mar-2022 close to Oct-2025; Noida ~4.5 yrs from Aug-2021 close.

rev_share_dial.unit: fraction of gross revenue to AAI
rev_share_dial.note: Not an allowable cost in aero tariff (SSA 3.1.1).

rev_share_mial.unit: fraction of gross revenue to AAI

rev_share_mopa.unit: fraction of gross revenue to Govt of Goa

rev_share_nagpur.unit: fraction of gross revenue to MIHAN India Ltd
rev_share_nagpur.note: GMR's original bid was 5.76%, raised to 14.49% after negotiation (SC judgment 2022-05-09). The real Nagpur comparator.

rev_share_nmia.unit: fraction of gross revenue to CIDCO

ppf_aai_2019.note: International pax pay 2x; indexed annually to CPI-IW (https://www.itln.in/adani-to-takeover-ahmedabad-lucknow-and-mangaluru-airports-for-50-years-aviation). 50-year leases.

ppf_noida.unit: INR per passenger to the state (YIAPL)

state_stake_precedent.note: ZMI's 20% state stake (AAI 10% + state 10%) is below the 26% norm (game choice).

madc_role.value: Maharashtra Airport Development Company: Govt of Maharashtra company that spearheads MIHAN; holds 51% of MIHAN India Ltd (AAI 49%), which owned/ran Nagpur airport and awarded GMR its 30-yr concession
madc_role.period: 2006 MoU; SC judgment 2022-05-09; GMR took over 2026-06-25
madc_role.note: Role verified, so 'MADC' may be named as the state's 10% partner. MADC does not run the airport itself (MIL did, GMR now does); say 'MADC, the State of Maharashtra's airport and MIHAN developer'.

fairfax_bial_stake.note: Brief's 74% includes the 10% Siemens stake bought for USD 255 m; Fairfax AR reports 64% held at 2024-12-31 with the Siemens 10% purchase setting the price; AAI/KSIIDC 13% each per the brief (not re-verified).

revenue_per_pax.note: Derived: DEL 7,568 cr / 78.7 m; BLR 4,239 cr / 44.5 m; BOM 4,571 cr / 55 m.

ebitda_margin.note: BOM derived: PBILDT 1,599 / TOI 4,021 (CARE). DEL and BOM margins are after 46% / 38.7% revenue share; BLR's modest revenue share explains ~70%.

bial_valuation.note: USD 2.55 bn from Fairfax (Siemens 10% for USD 255 m, DCF-supported); INR at ~85.5/USD is my conversion (estimate). BIAL ROE 14% (2024).

peak_day_to_annual.note: Derived from reported figures: 78.7 m (FY26) / 2.53 lakh (record day 30 Nov 2025). Peak day is 1.17x the average day. ATM equivalent: 455,169 / 1,392 = 327.

design_day_movements_by_level.unit: movements on a peak day for the traffic moved in
design_day_movements_by_level.source: build.md (BLR record 837, HYD 607, BOM 1,036) ; https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/GMRINFRA_15122025214736_15122025-monthlytrafficdataNov.pdf (DEL 1,414 on 22 Dec 2025)
design_day_movements_by_level.note: AMD ~300 is an estimate (13.4 m pax/yr). L1 BLR; L2 +HYD+AMD; L3 +BOM; L4 +DEL.

shift_to_day.note: A shift samples part of the peak day; scale its money to the whole day by movements.

annualise.value: annual = shift_money x shift_to_day x peak_day_to_annual; era = 5 x annual (growth applied per year)

shift_money_multiplier.note: No inflation needed: a Level-1 shift (~110 movements, ~16,500 pax) is already ~Rs 1 crore of revenue, and single calls swing Rs 0.3-5 lakh. Keep real rupees; if tuning needs more bite, raise this one number and show it in the UI.

financial_close.note: Default gearing 70:30; slider 60-80%. Repayment: sculpted (default) or equal instalments.

opening_tariff.note: Greenfield UDF precedent (NMIA); AERA resets it each era from RAB x 15.41% RoE (WACC 12.89%) less 30% of non-aero.
